item.title: Stéphane Dumas (basketball)
item.description: Stéphane Louis André Dumas (born 14 September 1978) is a French basketball coach and former player who played as a point guard. From 2020 to 2022, he was the assistant basketball coach for Gran Canaria of the Liga ACB, alongside Spaniard Alejandro Paniagua, the current coach of the Equatorial Guinea national team.
